body:
Real, shared internal/gauntlet compliance package, replacing the earlier
NORTHSTAR-only Gauntlet concept with a narrow, real v0: (1) every
auto-generated article now gets a real disclosure/disclaimer -- closing a
real gap where none of the three live generators (movers-watcher,
eps-processor, guidance-watcher) had one; (2) ticker references go through
gauntlet's LinkIssuer/PlainIssuer (thin wrapper over internal/tickerlink);
(3) SKULDMARK-25 instrument IDs (v1 layout) surface alongside ticker
references wherever one was already minted (movers-watcher mints for
watchlist names with CIK+Exchange on file; eps/guidance propagate the ID
already minted by prwatch at discovery time -- no new minting logic).

New gauntlet_test.go + 2 movers-watcher tests. go build/vet/test ./... clean
across the whole module.

Commit: PRRJECT_FATBABY 64025b6.

⚓ ☃
title: GAUNTLET v0: disclaimers + ticker linking + SKULDMARK on every auto-generated article
